# Warlock Devtools

> Package: `@warlock.js/devtools`

> Development-only dashboard for Warlock.js apps at /__warlock: request timeline, queries with EXPLAIN, N+1 detection, dev mailbox, logs, cache operations and the route map. Refuses to run outside development.

## Skills

- [devtools-overview](@warlock.js/devtools/devtools-overview/SKILL.md): Development-only dashboard for Warlock.js apps at `/__warlock`: request timeline (router + page middleware, loaders, render, deferred values), every SQL/Mongo query with EXPLAIN, N+1 warnings naming the file and line, a dev mailbox, logs, cache operations, the route map and an API docs page (`/__warlock/docs`, the OpenAPI 3.1 document of the app rendered with Scalar or Swagger UI at `/__warlock/docs/swagger`, with OpenAPI and Postman downloads). Use for: "why is this page slow", "which queries does this request run", "find N+1 queries", "see the email my app just sent in dev", "open the dashboard", "browse my API docs in dev", "see the OpenAPI for my routes", "open Swagger UI for my API", "export my routes to Postman". Install with `warlock add devtools`; never registered in warlock.config.ts. Not this package: production monitoring/APM or OpenTelemetry export — use `http.tracing` hooks in @warlock.js/core; slow-query logging in production — subscribe to cascade `dataSourceRegistry.on("query")` yourself.
